title: Converge distribution before generated quality
summary: Human review found shared-reader and measured-motion gaps in the exact distribution exemplar. Make that convergence and its visual checkpoint current; preserve generated-quality, primitive-amortization, and semantic-LLM work behind explicit dependencies so it can be re-evaluated after resolution rather than discarded.
